question: What meter may be in the ear and middle of hall and assembly?
premises: It may be in the ear.
It may be in the middle of hall and assembly.
inference: Meter may occur in the ear and in the middle of hall and assembly.
uncertainties: Whether chandaṃ and chandameva are distinct.
plain_english: Meter may be in the ear and in the middle of hall and assembly; that is meter.
